description: Supported entry points and public addresses of Legend Mod, read by developers/audit/audit.js and developers/tests/repo-integrity.js. entryPoints: what players, browsers, the userscript, the extension and the apps open first (their references make other files ACTIVE). compatibility: addresses kept for old installations, old links and other sites (COMPATIBILITY when nothing current uses them). dataDrivenCollections: folders whose file names come from data at run time (agar.io's configuration), so a dynamic pattern in an active file reaches every file in them. Globs: ** any depth, * inside one folder.
